seo.title: About SafeTools | Our Mission for Digital Privacy
seo.description: Learn about the mission, manifesto, and technology behind SafeToolsthe zero-server toolkit built to protect your digital sovereignty.

manifesto.title: Privacy is a Human Right.
manifesto.description: SafeTools was built to bridge the gap between powerful professional utilities and absolute data sovereignty. We believe you shouldn't have to sacrifice your identity for a PDF conversion or video transcode.

zeroServer.title: Zero-Server Policy
zeroServer.description: Your files are never uploaded. We process everything locally in your browser using WebAssembly and Client-side JS. This ensures true data sovereignty.

noPersistence.title: No Data Persistence
noPersistence.description: Once you close the tab, your session and files are purged from memory. We don't use databases or server-side logs. Your workspace is temporary and secure.

identityProtection.title: Identity Protection
identityProtection.description: No tracking, no analytics, and no fingerprinting. We don't even know you're hereand we like it that way. We prioritize anonymity over metrics.

engine.title: Hardware Performance. Zero Server Latency.
engine.description: We utilize cutting-edge browser technologies to move processing power from the cloud to your local CPU and GPU. Using WebAssembly (WASM), we run high-performance C++ and Rust binaries directly in your browser's V8 engine.

items.name: ONNX Runtime
items.desc: Client-side AI for image upscaling and OCR.

cta.title: Ready to take control?
cta.description: Explore our full suite of professional utilities and experience the power of private, localized file processing.
